technique_name: Tell me something interesting about the Boston Tea Party
description: The Boston Tea Party was a protest against the British taxes on tea, which occurred in December 16, 1773. It was an iconic event that served as an important step towards the American Revolution. As part of the protest, around 60 colonists dressed as Native Americans boarded some British ships and threw more than 300 chests of tea overboard into Boston Harbor.
